summary: Manages project snapshots, including creation, file enumeration, difference computation, change analysis, validation, and workspace management.
responsibilities: Create project snapshots by enumerating target files and generating file metadata.
Compute and analyze differences between project snapshots.
Validate and commit project snapshot changes.
Manage filesystem workspaces and identification for project snapshots.
relationships: Project change analysis compares previous and current snapshots.
Project snapshot creation enumerates target files and generates file snapshots containing hashes and modification timestamps.
Snapshot diffing computes differences between previous and current project snapshots.
design_decisions: Modular organization of snapshot creation, diffing, analysis, and commitment into separate modules.
Dataclasses or structured models representing project change analysis results.
